HomeHero.title: Dale un destino a cada llamada
HomeHero.descriptionOne: Your team has enough on its plate.
HomeHero.descriptionTwo: Vinotoraup takes customer calls and follow-ups off it.

HomeTakeRecurring.descriptionOne: When routine calls and follow-ups fill the day, Vinotoraup can take on the work you choose to outsource.
HomeTakeRecurring.descriptionTwo: You decide what we handle, what stays in-house, and when a case comes back to your team.

coveragePage.title: Coverage for the Calls
coveragePage.description: A customer needs an update. Another has a payment question. A third cannot finish an application. Vinotoraup takes on the customer contact you choose to move outside your team.

application.title: Application Support
application.description: Missing information, status questions, and next steps

start-with-requests.title: Start with Incoming Requests
start-with-requests.description: When customers reach out, they need to know someone has picked up the issue. Our team handles requests within the agreed scope and routes cases that need an internal decision to yours.

keep-follow-ups-moving.title: Keep Follow-Ups Moving
keep-follow-ups-moving.description: Some conversations begin with your business. Vinotoraup can handle agreed reminders, information requests, and customer updates so open tasks have a next step.

cover-more-than-calls.title: Cover More Than Calls
cover-more-than-calls.description: Customer contact can include calls and other agreed communication channels. We define the channels and the work involved before the service begins.

CoverageKeepCustomer.description: One customer may contact you about an application, then need a verification or a follow-up. Covering several functions together can reduce unnecessary transfers between separate support queues.

CoverageChangeScope.description: Begin with the work taking up the most time. If contact volumes or customer needs change, review which tasks Vinotoraup covers.

CoverageWhatWould.description: Tell us which customer conversations arrive most often and where your team needs more capacity.

UseCasesPage.title: The Reason for the Call
UseCasesPage.description: A borrower asking about a payment needs a different response from a customer checking an application. Vinotoraup covers the conversations that come up across financial services, following the process set by each business.

fintech.title: FinTech
fintech.description: Digital products can generate questions at any point in the customer journey.
fintech.descriptionAfter: Vinotoraup handles the agreed communication and passes decisions outside its scope to your team.

lending.title: Lending
lending.description: Borrowers may need help before an application is complete and long after a loan is issued.
lending.descriptionAfter: The work can cover one stage or several, depending on what your team needs.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.description: Customer contact continues beyond the first policy question.
insurance.descriptionAfter: Vinotoraup follows your instructions on what can be answered and what needs specialist review.

UseCasesOtherServices.description: Existing teams often need extra capacity for recurring contact. We can take on defined customer care, application, payment, or complaint-related tasks alongside your internal operation.

UseCasesYourBusiness.description: You decide which conversations Vinotoraup handles, which decisions stay in-house, and when a case moves between teams. The handoff is defined before customer contact begins.

UseCasesWhereDoes.description: Tell us what customers contact you about and which conversations take the most time. We’ll help define a scope that fits your operation.

HandoffPage.title: Make the Handoff Clear
HandoffPage.description: Vinotoraup takes on the customer contact you agree to transfer. We define the tasks, instructions, and escalation points together so both teams know what happens when a request comes in.

HandoffKeepOpen.description: A handoff also needs a clear next step. When a case requires internal review, both teams should know who takes it over and who contacts the customer afterward.

HandoffReviewWhat.description: Customer questions, volumes, and priorities can shift. We can review the scope and update the instructions or escalation points when your operation changes.

HandoffReady.description: You can start with one type of request. Tell us what you want covered, and we’ll work through the handoff with you.

stepOne.title: Show Us the Work
stepOne.description: Tell us why customers get in touch, which requests take the most time, and where follow-ups slow down. We use that picture to identify the work Vinotoraup could cover.

stepTwo.title: Draw the Boundaries
stepTwo.description: Before launch, we agree on four practical points:

stepThree.title: Prepare the Team
stepThree.description: We put the agreed workflows, customer information, and communication instructions in place. Your team reviews the scope before Vinotoraup begins handling those requests.

stepFour.title: Start Handling Contact
stepFour.description: Vinotoraup takes on the agreed calls and follow-ups. Requests outside the defined scope go to the person or team responsible for them.

PeoplePage.title: The People Behind the
PeoplePage.description: Vinotoraup provides call center outsourcing for financial businesses. Our role is to handle agreed customer contact with a clear understanding of what we can resolve and when your team needs to step in.

PeopleWeWork.description: Customers should receive answers that fit your business. Before handling contact, we agree on the instructions, information, and next steps the team will use.

stepOne.description: Understand why the customer is getting in touch.

stepTwo.title: Respond
stepTwo.description: Follow the agreed process and explain the next step clearly.

stepThree.title: Follow Through
stepThree.description: Complete the task or pass the case to the team responsible for it.

itemOne.title: Built for Financial Customer Contact
itemOne.description: Vinotoraup supports FinTech, lending, insurance, and other financial businesses. The conversations differ, but each setup starts with the same question: what does your team need us to handle?

itemTwo.title: Work Together as Needs Change
itemTwo.description: A new type of request may start reaching your team, or an existing process may change. The scope and instructions can be reviewed so the external team continues to work from your current requirements.

itemThree.title: Tell Us About Your Team
itemThree.description: Let us know which customer conversations your people handle today and where they need support. We’ll discuss what Vinotoraup could take on.
